title: rosa onoei f. rosea
intro: Rosa onoei f. rosea, commonly known as the Japanese rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa onoei f. rosea include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help in managing conditions such as arthritis, high blood pressure, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
